understanding: The supplied source resolves Paxos selection, constructor-local initialization, and asynchronous loop startup. runReplica obtains registration results from the master before selecting Paxos. paxos.New initializes local protocol state, registers six message channels, and launches run before returning. The run goroutine performs peer setup, conditionally launches execution and batching workers, launches client connection handling, and dispatches messages to handlers. These observations establish startup and dispatch behavior, not completed authority acquisition, recovery, decision formation, or application.

activities.purpose: Dispatch proposals and protocol messages to decision-processing handlers.
activities.realization_summary: One run goroutine selects among proposal, Prepare, Accept, Commit, CommitShort, reply, recovery, and batching channels. Handler semantics remain unread in this packet.
variants: When BatchingEnabled returns true, proposal reception is disabled after handling a proposal and restored on a fastClockChan event.
unknowns: The dispatched handlers' admission, support, decision, and error semantics are not established.
Other workers and RPC methods may access shared state; run-loop serialization does not establish exclusive ownership.

activities.purpose: Initialize local role and ballot context for a newly constructed Paxos replica.
activities.realization_summary: The constructor copies the caller-supplied isLeader flag and initializes replica-wide ballot fields to -1. The startup caller obtains that flag from a Ready master registration reply. This establishes local initialization only.
variants: The supplied isLeader flag determines the initial local IsLeader value.
unknowns: Master-side assignment semantics and their relationship to protocol authority are unread.
Fresh construction versus restart behavior depends on unread base-replica initialization and recovery paths.

behaviors.protocol_context: Startup with a Config whose lowercased Protocol is paxos.
implementation_guards: registerWithMaster returns only after Master.Register succeeds with reply.Ready true.
The Paxos constructor is selected by strings.ToLower(c.Protocol) == "paxos".
reads: Config address, alias, port, master address, protocol, and ReplicaAddrs
Master registration reply ReplicaId, NodeList, and IsLeader

external_effects: Dials the master and invokes Master.Register.
Calls paxos.New with the registration results and f = (len(c.ReplicaAddrs) - 1) / 2.
Attempts rpc.Register for the constructed replica.
Installs HTTP RPC handlers and serves a TCP listener on port + 1000.
important_branches: Dial failures retry after time.Sleep(4); unsuccessful registration calls retry in the inner loop.
A successful registration with Ready false sleeps and retries.
rpc.Register and http.Serve return values are not checked in the supplied caller.
async_boundaries: paxos.New launches run before returning to this caller
existing_protections: Paxos construction follows an error-free Ready registration response.
unknowns: Master.Register implementation and the guarantees attached to Ready and IsLeader are unread.
The relationship between configured ReplicaAddrs cardinality and returned NodeList cardinality is not established.

crtInstance, maxRecvBallot, smallestDefaultBallot, and executedUpTo initialized to -1

external_effects: Calls replica.New(alias, id, f, addrs, false, true, false, conf, logger).
Registers Prepare, Accept, Commit, CommitShort, PrepareReply, and AcceptReply with their respective channels.
important_branches: No constructor-local branch waits for peer connections, recovery, application startup, or protocol readiness.
async_boundaries: Launches go r.run() before returning r.

behaviors.protocol_context: The locally initialized replica launched by paxos.New.
behaviors.trigger: The run goroutine begins and subsequently receives channel events.

reads: Protocol message channels, instancesToRecover, and fastClockChan
writes: Package-level fastClockChan initialized to a buffered channel of capacity one
external_effects: Invokes peer connection and peer ordering setup.
Synchronously dispatches received events to handlePropose, handlePrepare, handleAccept, handleCommit, handleCommitShort, handlePrepareReply, handleAcceptReply, or recover.

The select has no dedicated shutdown case.
